maintainer_question: Does retaining the VCRTool test fixture in PR #61 require removing mix_stderr to bind to the proposed Click constructor?
selection: Prefer a case fresh to UpgradePilot with an exact lockfile transition, a direct binding that can answer a maintainer question, and a complete small Python source inventory. The target need not exhibit the incompatibility.
search_scope: All regular tracked .py files at the exact VCRTool PR head. Run the synthetic controls separately from the real comparison.

required.missing_proposed_definition: Keep the known old binding and report proposed signature unavailable even when the target span is present.
required.receiver_unresolved: For the same real call, preserve an undetermined outcome when constructor receiver binding is left unresolved.

forbidden: Attributing unrelated or potentially unbound calls to Click
Claiming proposed compatibility from an absent definition
Claiming runtime test success, output-behavior equivalence, or merge readiness
Presenting prior exposure or one local comparison as independent usefulness or measured human time
disposition_rule: A verified new material call or fewer non-required candidates without a required miss earns a development signal. Equivalent coverage and review volume retain the existing method. Tool errors or file omissions affecting the comparison are inconclusive.
